evidence.reason: `render_service_text` only recognizes a literal line start of `ExecStart=`. systemd accepts whitespace around `=`, so a template containing `ExecStart = ...` is not counted. If a template contains both forms, the renderer replaces the unspaced directive and leaves the spaced one as a second effective command, bypassing the existing exactly-one-ExecStart validation. This is an implementation error in the intended replacement/validation behavior; the smallest compatible repair is to parse directives while allowing whitespace before `=` and reject more than one effective `ExecStart`.
